headline: Reuters reports heightened risks to commercial shipping around the Strait of Hormuz
india_implication: Analyst assessment: disruption near Hormuz could raise shipping, insurance and energy-import risks for India; monitor official advisories and oil-market effects.

headline: Reuters reports record-high freight costs for Russian Urals oil shipments to India in early October
india_implication: Analyst assessment: higher freight costs may reduce the economic advantage of some Russian crude purchases; track freight rates, discounts and delivered costs.

headline: Reuters reports delays and possible cancellations affecting India-bound sunflower-oil cargoes amid Black Sea disruption
india_implication: Analyst assessment: disrupted Black Sea flows could affect edible-oil availability and prices; monitor shipment status and substitution toward other oils.
